items.title: Wild Fourth-Quarter Finish Goes FIU’s Way in Miami
items.summary: A 35-yard field goal by FIU kicker Robert Czeremcha as time expired lifted home-standing FIU past Missouri State here Saturday, 23-20, capping off a wild series of plays over the final seven minutes of the Conference USA thriller.

items.title: O'Neal Named as Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: Missouri State safety J.J. O'Neal (5th Yr., Rogersville, Mo.) was announced this week as one of 65 nominees for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy, recognizing outstanding college football players from across the country who began their careers as walk-ons and have distinguished themselves through their performance, determination and perseverance.

items.title: Football Bears Begin November Stretch with Trip to FIU
items.summary: Missouri State begins a four-game November stretch this Saturday (Nov. 7) when the Bears make their first-ever trip to Pittbull Stadium in Miami to take on the  FIU Panthers at 3 p.m. (Central) on ESPN+.

items.title: McDonald Named to Ray Guy Award List for Week 9
items.summary: Missouri State punter Stewart McDonald (Jr., Rogersville, Mo.) was named to the Ray Guy Award "Ray's 8" for week nine of the college football schedule, the organization announced Monday (Nov. 2).

items.title: Bears WR Myers Added to Biletnikoff Award Watch List
items.summary: The Tallahassee Quarterback Club (TQC) Foundation, Inc., the Florida-based creator and sponsor of the prestigious Biletnikoff Award, has announced its fourth in-season additions to the Biletnikoff Award Watch List, which includes Missouri State wide receiver Isaiah Myers (5th Yr., Cincinnati, Ohio).

items.title: Bears Get Defensive in 24-3 Win over Sam Houston
items.summary: Missouri State racked up 313 total yards and held visiting Sam Houston to 26 rushing yards on 25 carries on the night to pull away late in a 24-3 victory here Tuesday.

items.title: Missouri State Announces Upcoming Fan Rallies in Miami and KC
items.summary: Missouri State Athletics and the Missouri State University Alumni Association invite Bears fans and alumni to join them for upcoming road rallies in Miami and Kansas City.

items.title: Football Bears Back Home Tuesday to Host Sam Houston
items.summary: Missouri State closes out its October slate on Tuesday when the Bears entertain Sam Houston in a nationally-televised ESPN2 showdown at 7 p.m. The "Black Out" game will mark the first-ever meeting between the Bears and Bearkats as CUSA and FBS foes.

items.title: Strong Second Half Pushes Delaware Past Bears in Newark
items.summary: A strong second half and good field position helped home-standing Delaware to a 61-38 victory over visiting Missouri State here Tuesday in the highest-scoring Conference USA game since 2017.

items.title: Lloyd, Obeid Earn CUSA Football Weekly Honors
items.summary: For their roles in Missouri State's home victory over Kennesaw State last week, Bears football standouts Jared "Bird" Lloyd and Yousef Obeid were named Conference USA Players of the Week for their respective positions.
